apiKey.label: OpenAirLog API key
apiKey.help: A read-only OpenAirLog API key with the flights:read permission.

homebase.label: Homebase (ICAO)
homebase.help: Four-letter ICAO airport code, e.g. EDDF for Frankfurt or EDDM for Munich.

flightScnrPiUrl.label: FlightScnrPi JSON URL
flightScnrPiUrl.help: HTTPS URL where the current flight information is sent.

flightScnrPiToken.label: FlightScnrPi token
flightScnrPiToken.help: Secret token used to authenticate the FlightScnrPi JSON endpoint.
